I updated wrap.py to:

- Preserve paragraphs: blank lines separate paragraphs; multiple blank lines collapse to a single separator in the output (an empty string ""), with no leading/trailing separators.
- Never split URLs starting with http:// or https://. If such a URL is longer than width it is placed on its own line.
- Continue splitting non-URL words longer than width into width-sized chunks.

If you'd like, I can add unit tests or handle additional URL-like schemes (ftp://, mailto:, etc.).
